description: This file defines the final, immutable class EffectedResources within the package org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers.tree. It acts as a wrapper to hold two sets of resources that are either granted or revoked, providing methods to create instances, retrieve the resource sets, and override standard Object methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: EffectedResources
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating sets of granted and revoked resources, providing creation and accessor methods, along with overridden equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EffectedResources instance with specified granted and revoked resource sets, checking for null arguments.

methods.description: Returns the set of granted resources.

methods.name: getRevokedResources
methods.description: Returns the set of revoked resources.
